en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a central town square with cobblestone paving. A prominent building with a clock tower and steeple (likely the town hall) stands on the left, flanked by gabled houses with shopfronts. Vintage cars and bicycles are parked around a fountain in the middle of the square. On the right is a grand three‑storey building with balconies and signage for a guesthouse or hotel. The caption at the bottom reads "Pulsnitz/Sa. Hauptmarkt," indicating this is the main market square of Pulsnitz in Saxony, Germany.
